Name: Eldritch Horse and Stable
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][size=5][b][u]Eldritch Horse & Stable[/u][/b][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][size=4]This is a simple mod that changes your horse into an eldritch tentacle monster from another dimension. It's presence also changes the look of the stable that appears to be...alive?[/size]

[size=4]Same rules apply to your new friend - put a hat on them, feed them carrots etc. [/size]

[size=4]If you don't like the hoof sound I suggest using[/size][size=4] my new mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55711?published=1]Hoof Sound Framework[/url][/size][/left]
[left][size=4]and select "Slither" for added effect. [/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[size=4]Should be compatible with Horse Overhaul and other mods that change the horse rules or behavior. [/size]

[size=4]This mod offers a config toggle to remove the eldritch stable if it messes with your aesthetic.[/size]

[size=4]FAQ's[/size]

[size=4]Q: Does this mod use AI?[/size]
[size=4]A: No, this is original art made by me. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Can I alter or translate this mod?[/size]
[size=4]A: Yes translations are okay and welcomed. If you want to alter it in some way please ask and/or credit me. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Is this mod compatible with?.....[/size]
[size=4]A: Probably but if you find an issue please let me know. [/size]

Manifest.Name: Eldritch Horse and Stable
Manifest.Description: Replaces the vanilla horse and stable with cozy eldritch abominations.
Manifest.Author: CozyPsychologist
